eyebrow: Statistics & Probability for Data Science · Chapter 6
subtitle: Lesson 28 · Correlation, Causation & Experiments

steps.label: Slope
steps.sub: Change in y per +1 in x

code:
from scipy import stats

res = stats.linregress(sqft, price)
print(res.slope, res.intercept)
# 0.1493  45.16

print(res.rvalue**2)
# 0.944
caption: 60 illustrative homes: sqft vs. price in $ thousands.

code:
xm, ym = sqft.mean(), price.mean()
b1 = ((sqft-xm)*(price-ym)).sum() \
     / ((sqft-xm)**2).sum()
b0 = ym - b1*xm
print(round(b1, 4), round(b0, 2))
# 0.1493  45.16
caption: Identical to linregress, so no magic.

eyebrow: Trust the line only so far

steps.label: Plot residuals
steps.sub: Curves or funnels mean bad model

code:
print(b0 + b1*2000)     # ~343.7

n = len(sqft)
t = stats.t.ppf(0.975, n-2)
lo = res.slope - t*res.stderr
hi = res.slope + t*res.stderr
print(round(lo, 4), round(hi, 4))
# 0.1398  0.1588
caption: 95% CI for the slope. Never extrapolate.
